title: Large sticky notes slow down plasmashell startup
line: A Sticky Note holding megabytes of pasted text no longer keeps the desktop and panel from appearing for most of a minute at login.
explanation:
Pasted or dropped text is stored as a single paragraph with a
per line, and Qt Quick's text renderer processes a paragraph as a whole, looking up each line with a linear scan, so a 6 MB note kept the render thread (and with it the whole shell) busy for about 30 s. On top of that, the text was set while the applet was still being sized, so the whole document was laid out again about five times during startup. The note loader now turns line breaks outside lists into separate paragraphs with the same spacing, so only the visible paragraphs are rendered, and the text is set once the applet has its final size, right before the saved scroll position is restored.

commits.message:
applets/notes: don't block startup with large notes

Pasted text ends up in one paragraph with line breaks, which Qt Quick
lays out and renders as a whole, and resizes during startup lay it out
again each time. Load line breaks as paragraphs and set the text once.

BUG: 499057

media.caption: Master: restarting plasmashell with a 6 MB pasted note; the screen stays black and the panel is still missing after 50 s
With the fix: same note file, desktop, note and panel are up after about 7 s
Master, 10 s after plasmashell starts: still nothing drawn
With the fix, 10 s after plasmashell starts: desktop, note (at its saved scroll position) and panel

review.text:
Solid profiling and a major real-world startup improvement (47 s down to ~6 s for a 6 MB pasted note) by splitting
line breaks into paragraphs with preserved margins/indentation and deferring initial text assignment until after startup sizing. However, deferring root.textLoaded introduces a data-loss race in applets/notes/qml/main.qml because two note.save() paths are not guarded against saving before the note text has been loaded.
changes: Guard root.note.save(...) in both throttledTextSaver.onTriggered and mainTextArea.onActiveFocusChanged with root.textLoaded (matching Component.onDestruction) so an unloaded empty TextArea can never overwrite the note file on disk.

Ensure mainTextArea still receives root.note.noteText if it gains activeFocus before Qt.callLater sets root.textLoaded = true (otherwise the Binding with when: root.textLoaded && !mainTextArea.activeFocus never fires, leaving the note blank and overwriting the saved file on focus-out or timer).
